description_en: Queries a list of DSW instances
kebab_example: aliyun pai-dsw list-instances --workspace-id 40823 --instance-name training_data --resource-id ALL --status Running --payment-type PayAsYouGo --accessibility PRIVATE --accelerator-type CPU --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order DESC --instance-id dsw-730xxxxxxxxxx --labels key1=value1 key2=value2 key3=value3 --create-user-id 123450000067890 --gpu-type NVIDIA_A10 --min-cpu 2000 --max-cpu 30000 --min-gpu 100 --max-gpu 8000 --min-memory 4 --max-memory 48 --min-gpu-memory 8 --max-gpu-memory 16 --image-name modelscope:1.9.4-pytorch2.0.1tensorflow2.13.0-cpu-py38-ubuntu20.04 --tag Value=value1 Key=tag1 --oversold-info ForceQuotaOverSold --oversold-type AcceptQuotaOverSold --create-time-after 2024-01-12T14:36:01Z --create-time-before 2024-01-12T15:36:01Z --api-version 2022-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstances

parameters.help_en: Filters by workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh:
按工作空间ID筛选；如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html。
默认值为空，此时会使用当前子账号的“默认工作空间”，如何查看默认工作空间，请参见GetDefaultWorkspace (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/developer-reference/api-aiworkspace-2021-02-04-getdefaultworkspace)。
如果需要查询所有工作空间的实例（即不针对某个特定的工作空间进行筛选，而是列出该region跨工作空间的所有实例），请填写ALL
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The instance name. If specified, instances are searched by name using fuzzy match with case insensitivity. Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称。如果填写，则根据输入值对实例名称进行搜索。搜索行为是模糊匹配+大小写不敏感。默认为空
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: Filters by resource quota ID. For information about how to obtain the resource quota ID, see ListQuotas (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pai/developer-reference/api-aiworkspace-2021-02-04-listquotas)
parameters.help_zh:
按资源配额的ID进行筛选，如何获取资源配额ID请参见ListQuotas (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/developer-reference/api-aiworkspace-2021-02-04-listquotas)。
默认值为空，此时只返回后付费资源组的实例。
填 ALL 会返回所有的实例
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: Filters by instance status. Default value: empty, which queries instances in all states
parameters.help_zh: 根据输入值对实例状态进行筛选。默认为空，此时查询所有状态的实例
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Filters by payment type (subscription or pay-as-you-go). Default value: empty, which queries instances of all payment types
parameters.help_zh: 根据输入值对实例的付费类型（预付费或后付费）进行筛选。默认为空，此时查询所有付费类型的实例
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en: Filters by workspace visibility of the instance. Default value: empty, which queries instances of all visibility types. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
根据输入值对实例的工作空间可见性进行筛选。默认为空，此时查询所有可见性的实例。可取值如下：
PRIVATE（默认值）：表示工作空间内自己以及管理员可见。
PUBLIC：为工作空间所有用户可见
parameters.name: accessibility

parameters.help_en: Filters by accelerator type of the instance. Default value: empty, which queries instances of all accelerator types. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
根据输入值对实例的加速类型进行筛选。默认为空，此时查询所有加速类型的实例。可取值如下：
CPU：无计算加速，只使用CPU计算。
GPU：使用GPU进行计算加速
parameters.name: accelerator_type

parameters.help_en: The page number for paging query of instances. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 实例分页查询的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of instances returned per page in a paging query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询每页返回的实例数量，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The field used for sorting
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: DESC and ASC. Default value: DESC
parameters.help_zh: 排列顺序。可取值DESC或ASC，默认为DESC
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: If specified, filters instances by exact instance ID. For information about how to obtain the instance ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470439.html. You can specify multiple IDs separated by commas
parameters.help_zh: 如果填写该项，则按实例ID进行精确筛选。如何获取实例ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470439.html。支持以逗号分隔的方式传入多个ID实现多选
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: If specified, filters instances by labels. A maximum of four label groups are supported, and multiple label groups are combined using AND conditions
parameters.help_zh: 如果填写该项，则根据输入值按照实例的标签进行筛选，最多支持4组标签，多组标签之间以AND条件进行组合筛选
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: If specified, filters instances by the creator user ID
parameters.help_zh: 如果填写该项，则根据输入值对实例的创建者UserId进行筛选
parameters.name: create_user_id

parameters.help_en: If specified, filters instances by GPU model
parameters.help_zh: 如果填写该项，则根据输入值对实例的GPU 型号进行筛选
parameters.name: gpu_type

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of CPUs, in units of 0.001 CPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 CPU. If specified, only instances with a CPU count greater than the specified value are returned
parameters.help_zh: 最小的CPU数量，单位是0.001 CPU，1000表示1个CPU。如果填写该项，则筛选出CPU数量大于输入值的实例
parameters.name: min_cpu

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of CPUs, in units of 0.001 CPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 CPU. If specified, only instances with a CPU count less than the specified value are returned
parameters.help_zh: 最大的CPU数量，单位是0.001 CPU，1000表示1个CPU。如果填写该项，则筛选出CPU数量小于输入值的实例
parameters.name: max_cpu

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of GPUs, in units of 0.001 GPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 GPU. If specified, only instances with a GPU count greater than the specified value are returned
parameters.help_zh: 最小的GPU数量，单位是0.001 GPU，1000表示1个GPU。如果填写该项，则筛选出GPU数量大于输入值的实例
parameters.name: min_gpu

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of GPUs, in units of 0.001 GPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 GPU. If specified, only instances with a GPU count less than the specified value are returned
parameters.help_zh: 最大的GPU数量，单位是0.001 GPU，1000表示1个GPU。如果填写该项，则筛选出GPU数量小于输入值的实例
parameters.name: max_gpu

parameters.help_en: The minimum memory size in GB. If specified, only instances with memory greater than the specified value are returned
parameters.help_zh: 最小的机器内存数，单位是G。如果填写该项，则筛选出内存大于输入值的实例
parameters.name: min_memory

parameters.help_en: The maximum memory size in GB. If specified, only instances with memory less than the specified value are returned
parameters.help_zh: 最大的机器内存数，单位是G。如果填写该项，则筛选出内存小于输入值的实例
parameters.name: max_memory

parameters.help_en: The minimum GPU memory per card in GB. If specified, only instances with GPU memory greater than the specified value are returned
parameters.help_zh: 最小单卡GPU显存大小，单位是G。如果填写该项，则筛选出GPU显存大于输入值的实例
parameters.name: min_gpu_memory

parameters.help_en: The maximum GPU memory per card in GB. If specified, only instances with GPU memory less than the specified value are returned
parameters.help_zh: 最大单卡 GPU 显存大小，单位是 G。如果填写该项，则筛选出 GPU 显存小于输入值的实例
parameters.name: max_gpu_memory

parameters.help_en: The image name. If specified, filters instances by the image name used by the instance
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名。如果填写该项，则根据输入值对实例使用的镜像名称进行筛选
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. If specified, filters instances by tags. A maximum of four tag groups are supported, and multiple tag groups are combined using AND conditions
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。如果填写该项，则根据输入值按照实例的标签进行筛选，最多支持 4 组标签，多组标签之间以 AND 条件进行组合筛选
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The idle resource type actually used by the instance. If specified, filters instances by the idle resource type actually in use. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
实例实际使用的闲时资源类型。如果填写该项，则根据输入值对实例实际使用的闲时资源类型进行筛选。支持的值：
ForbiddenQuotaOverSold：使用保障资源
ForceQuotaOverSold：使用闲时资源
PendingQuotaOverSold：待分配
parameters.name: oversold_info

parameters.help_en: The idle resource type specified by the user. If specified, filters instances by the idle resource type. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
用户指定的闲时资源类型。如果填写，则根据输入值对实例的闲时资源类型进行筛选。支持的值：
ForceQuotaOverSold：只使用闲时资源
AcceptQuotaOverSold：可接受闲时资源
ForbiddenQuotaOverSold：使用保障资源
parameters.name: oversold_type

parameters.help_en: If specified, only instances created at or after this time are returned
parameters.help_zh: 如果填写，则筛选出创建时间晚于（或等于）该时间的实例
parameters.name: create_time_after

parameters.help_en: If specified, only instances created at or before this time are returned
parameters.help_zh: 如果填写，筛选出创建时间早于（或等于）该时间的实例
parameters.name: create_time_before
